newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Credit Suisse seen launching Swiss internet banking.
newsitem.headline: Credit Suisse seen launching Swiss internet banking.

text.p: Credit Suisse is about to become the first of Switzerland's three big banks to launch retail banking services on the internet, Swiss newspapers reported.
The Sunday paper SonntagsZeitung and the business bi-weekly Finanz und Wirtschaft said the launch of internet banking would be announced at a news conference on Thursday.
The bank itself would say only that the event concerned "a new, attractive product in the area of direct banking."
Sonntagszeitung said the new service would allow customers to check account balances, pay bills or buy and sell stocks.
"Apparently, it (Credit Suisse) is the first Swiss bank to master the technical problems related to security and the compatability of the complex data processing elements," the SonntagsZeitung wrote.
It said Credit Suisse would use special encryption and decoding software to protect data passing between customers and the bank from being read by outsiders.
